themes.title: Fuel‑Price Crisis Spurs Right‑Wing Policy Push
themes.blurb: Surging fuel and diesel prices are driving high-profile policy demands from right-wing figures in both North America and Europe. While Donald Trump claims international coordination to release European energy reserves, Norwegian conservatives are pushing parliamentary initiatives to immediately slash fuel taxes.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump claims Europe and G7 partners agreed to immediately release diesel and oil reserves to offset record fuel costs linked to the Iran conflict.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP forms a joint opposition push in parliament demanding immediate cuts to diesel and petrol taxes as prices cross 31 NOK per liter.

themes.title: Right‑Wing Parties Gaining Regional Power
themes.blurb: Right-wing movement figures and parties are systematically consolidating political clout at the state and regional levels. From the Sweden Democrats securing executive leadership in key administrative regions to populist campaigns expanding candidate rosters and holding targeted regional rallies, subnational power remains a primary focus.
